The Argent Dawn thanks you for your efforts, $N.$B$BWith our blessing, take your pick between either this Seal of the Dawn or this Rune of the Dawn. You can use either of them instead of a standard Argent Dawn Commission to collect scourgestones on our behalf. Should you lose yours, speak with me and I'll get you a replacement.

texts.text0_1: Eager to get to Northrend, are you? The steam-powered Kraken sails from here to Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

b4ec47e81378f5e73fb3a237086840c7038e8c96.RewardText: I'm not sure that I like the sound of that one bit! The Lich King absconding with Ymiron can only mean trouble. Unfortunate that you weren't able to kill him along with his queen.$B$BStill, you've put a huge dent in their plans and bought us the valuable time that we need.$B$BAnd who knows, with the way you get around, you'll likely run into King Ymiron again. I'm sure that he won't fare so well the next time you meet.

b4efe3b8480990d23fcbd3264744545c41e54cdb.Text: Where's my damned helmet? Well, at least they left my sword here. Idiots.

b4f00450b6baec49e0289916e445273858f3d39b.LogDescription: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Omor the Unscarred and the drake, Nazan.  Return Gargolmar's Hand, Omor's Hoof and Nazan's Head to Gunny at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
b4f00450b6baec49e0289916e445273858f3d39b.QuestDescription: Quick, $c, there isn't much time.  Honor Hold's existence balances on the razor's edge!$B$BWe're caught between Hellfire Citadel in the west and the forces of the Burning Legion to the east.  With the Legion's attention turned toward the Dark Portal we must take this opportunity to strike at the fel orcs of Hellfire Citadel.  The key to this is to first break through their ramparts!$B$BGo there, slay their leaders, and then bring back proof to Gunny across the hall here from me!

b4f054ee3f549564c17e890d6e5404f35ac74566.LogDescription: Find Anilia in Xavian in Ashenvale.
b4f054ee3f549564c17e890d6e5404f35ac74566.QuestDescription: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!$B$B$n, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northwest. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.

b4f1688060d57b9728dcdba607e2865a3c76cd30.Text: Known throughout the lands, Antonio Perelli's goods now for sale near Sentinel Hill! I must move on soon, so make haste.

b4f3640a6ac0f20523b10b04cd60101a8d0ea53c.LogDescription: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
b4f3640a6ac0f20523b10b04cd60101a8d0ea53c.QuestDescription: You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.$B$BRemoving the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

b4f4aa2149d7594179d75481e241494f0da0538d.CompletionText: I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.$B$BIt is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.

b4f61ce6086f502994cc32429bcf563a298f7ea2.Text: Pathetic mortals! You will pay dearly.

b4f80bc273d57413d419fd9e56295311b13f482d.LogDescription: Gather 3 Corrupted Flowers and return them to Apprentice Vishael at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
b4f80bc273d57413d419fd9e56295311b13f482d.QuestDescription: The Ammen Fields to the west are the primary breeding ground of the local lasher population. With the corruption of the water table from the nearby lake, Botanist Taerix is worried that the lashers will not be able to repopulate themselves once we've cleansed the lake.$B$BGo to the Ammen Fields and pick some of the corrupted flowers for me so that I might take a look at them and see what can be done. You should be able to identify them by their uncharacteristic red petals.

b4fbd5e236e565eda9d5cc09326dbb48f18feba1.Text: If we reverse the Essence flows perhaps we can alter the polarity.

b4fc9f233831858a1ecb74d5939764ca000ee0fe.RewardText: This is very good material, and although I lack the talent to gauge the quality of these mana gems, we'll soon know if they possess the power needed to create spellfire robes...

b4fcc6ebbb8053357fa45affc4c91441bf1b1d61.Text: The dark lord laughs at you!

b4ffd42dae308cd91949b475f6c41d0d1a488187.RewardText: <Dama listens to Agadai's request.>$B$BI can't guarantee that there will be any wind riders available, but I'll see what I can do. As it is, we're having trouble keeping up with the demands of other buyers and outposts.
